描述_EN: the ming dynasty was a flourishing period for tile production. it is a bridge to the world of spirits and a platform for them to descend to earth. demon roof tiles were credited with deterrent powers for dispelling evil spirits similar to those of terrifying tomb guardian figures. on roofs the most common decoration was tiling. in asia, the roof, by virtue of its position on a building, is deemed a point of communication between heaven and earth. here the tile depicts the head, with its predatory bird's beak, of the fierce god of thunder. chinese builders sought to harness auspicious spiritual forces and repel evil spirits with applied ornamentation freighted with symbolic meaning.
描述_ZN: 明朝是一个瓦片生产的繁荣时期。 它是通向精神世界的桥梁，也是他们下凡的平台。 屋顶上的妖怪瓦被认为具有类似于可怕的守墓人的威慑力，可以驱除恶灵。 在屋顶上，最常见的装饰是瓦片。 在亚洲，屋顶由于其在建筑物上的位置，被认为是天与地之间的沟通点。 这里的瓦片描绘的是凶猛的雷神的头部，带有掠夺性的鸟嘴。 中国的建筑家们试图用充满象征意义的装饰品来驾驭吉祥的精神力量和驱除邪恶的灵魂。
